Title: How Aevo is Crafting a Full-Stack EVM L2 Derivatives Exchange | Julian Koh
Published: 2024-01-29 18:59:33 UTC
Description:
In today's interview we are joined by Julian, the co-founder of Aevo, formally known as Ribbon Finance. Today's conversation details the evolution of Ribbon into AEVO, an L2 derivatives exchange built using Optimism's OP stack for faster and cheaper trading. We learn about AEVO’s origins providing structured products to DeFi users and the decision to pivot to an L2 system to capture rising institutional interest in crypto options. They also touch on pre-launch futures markets as an effective user acquisition strategy. They close out on AEVO's plan to expand into an interoperable cross-chain ecosystem. Stay tuned for all of this and much more!

Title: Liquid Restaking Tokens: Crypto's Next Timebomb? | Analyst Round Table
Published: 2024-01-10 16:41:44 UTC
Description:
In this week's analyst table Dan and Sam are joined Ren and Pibblez of the Blockworks Research team to dive into the risks of liquid restaking tokens and the looming ETF approval. They debate whether these LRTs are ticking time bombs and if stakers understand the slashable exposure they're taking on. The crew also explores the viability of Celestia's data availability and if gaming and rollups will drive the demand needed to justify its towering $15B valuation. Other hot topics include Bitcoin NFT mania, StarkNet activating STRK for gas usage, and EtherScan's acquirement of SolScan.

Title: EigenLayer: The Endgame Coordination Layer | Sreeram Kannan and Soubhik Deb
Published: 2023-11-02 14:42:39 UTC
Description:
In this week's interview, EigenLayer CEO and Founder Sreeram Kannan and Principal Researcher Soubhik join us to unpack how EigenLayer aims to become the coordination infrastructure of Web3. They discuss the vision for EigenLayer as a platform that allows developers to build and integrate specialized protocols through a shared security model backed by Ethereum staking. Kannan outlines the roles of stakers, node operators, and developers building actively validated services (AVS) within the EigenLayer ecosystem. They also explore potential AVS use cases like rollups, bridges, fast finality, and applied cryptography. They close out by discussing potential enshrinement and the 2023-2024 roadmap. Enjoy!
